name: 29170 · West Columbia, SC
findings: ZIP 29170 (West Columbia) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29170 (West Columbia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29170 (West Columbia) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
